content:
ila: Quick heads-up — found a nasty edge where our SDK retry helper can double-submit POSTs if a coroutine is cancelled mid-request. Repro on emulator with adb network delay.

sam: thanks, can you paste the tiny repro?

ila: minimal: we use withContext(Dispatchers.IO) + call.execute(); catch IOException -> call.clone().execute(). When the coroutine cancels while execute() is blocking, the catch path still runs and clone() fires a second POST.

niko: clone() is stateless and won't see cancellation. That's the root cause. Which okhttp version?

ila: 4.11 on recent devices, 4.10 on older emus. Behavior changed after the bump — timeouts now surface slightly earlier and interact with coroutine cancellation.

qa-raj: any customer impact?

ila: one support ticket for duplicate orders. Low frequency but reproducible locally with network shaping.

sam: short term: change helper to not retry non-idempotent verbs (POST/PUT/DELETE) unless caller provides Idempotency-Key. Also add telemetry when a retry would have occurred.

niko: long term: replace execute-based helper with a cancellable wrapper using suspendCancellableCoroutine + Call.enqueue so cancellation cancels the underlying call. Example minimal pattern provided in PR template.

ila: also discovered an anti-pattern: doing sync token refresh inside an Interceptor while using the same client. That can deadlock or interleave with retries — isolate refresh on a dedicated OkHttpClient without auth interceptors.

ci-bot: created ticket SDK-5123: "Android SDK: prevent clone() retries on coroutine cancellation; introduce cancellable enqueue wrapper; add emulator fuzz test" and queued emulator run.

qa-raj: I'll run 1000 fuzz iterations on the emulator pool once build lands. If failure rate >0.1% we escalate.

sam: please include a tiny sample app in the PR (single Activity, cancel button, network shaping instructions) so others can reproduce quickly. Also add migration notes about retry semantics.

ila: will open PR with 1) remove naive clone retry, 2) add idempotency guard + telemetry, 3) provide cancellable await wrapper, 4) add emulator CI test and sample app. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
